title: The flats, Easter
logline: Easter morning on the flats: a plastic egg in a channel, pink, from some child's hunt, and the pup nosing it. The page draws the pink as the only color in a gray morning, and doesn't say the word.

panels.composition: Gray mudflats at low tide with a single pink plastic egg lying in a channel and a small three-legged dog nosing it, the pink the only color.
